meta.visibility_rule: body center above horizon (spherical: 0 deg; terrain: LOLA horizon mask at that azimuth)
meta.ephemeris: JPL DE421 via Skyfield; lunar frame MOON_ME_DE421 (NAIF moon_080317.tf, moon_pa_de421_1900-2050.bpc, pck00008.tpc)
meta.dem: LRO LOLA GDR LDEM_75S_240M (LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0, V2.0 2017-06-15), 240 m/pixel polar stereographic, reference radius 1737.4 km

map.projection: south polar stereographic, sphere R=1737.4 km, 0E up, 90E right

meta.hourly_file: data/hourly.bin (uint16 LE; header n_entries, n_series=4, n_hours; per entry: sun_t, earth_t, sun_s, earth_s as [count, initial_state, flip_hour...]; entries = 5 sites then grid points)
